diagram_previews.alt: Schematic (not to scale) of quadrilateral PQRS with Q inside triangle PRS, so the angle at Q is reflex; the dashed segment PR closes the triangle, and the dotted extension of PQ meets RS at T.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the insight that a reflex vertex lies inside the triangle of the other three, plus a distance inequality, a check of four cases and a construction.
